title: Page Not Found
tagline: The 404 page of glyphite.hornbaek.org: a lander crashes into the missing address
description: Shown when a page does not exist. The missing address is spelled out in rock, a lander drops toward it with about ten seconds of fuel, and whatever you do it ends in a crater. Built on the engine like any other game, so the address really breaks into chunks.
head: head.html

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: Pull on everything that falls. The drop takes about ten seconds at 4.
